P0_autonomous_open_sources: AcousticBrainz or equivalent full-song derived descriptors for T when available
LRCLIB or equivalent public synchronized lyric reference for Text when available
public full-song symbolic/annotation sources that require no per-user approval for M
P1_optional_research_datasets: DALI after authorized access; never required for core operation
P2_engineering_only: Apple/iTunes short previews for extraction regression and latency engineering

hard_rules: SHORT_PREVIEW never enters Matrix X or cohort generation readiness.
DALI public metadata match alone never counts as M_FULL or TEXT_FULL.
The prototype must remain executable without paid credits and without approval-gated datasets.
When a restricted research dataset is available, use it as validation/acceleration evidence, not as a single point of failure.
next_engineering_problem: Identify or derive a zero-credit, authorization-free full-song M representation for enough massive-hit candidates; otherwise select massive hits already covered by genuinely open full-song symbolic annotations.
